title: MW6 Aether Reliquary balance and playtest fixtures
purpose: Convert full-game balance into static, testable targets before final release E2E expands across every city, act, boss, class, and endgame loop.

sessionTargets.label: Prologue onboarding
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Learn movement, one fight, one loot pickup, one lore beat, and one save action without menu sprawl.

sessionTargets.label: Major city arc
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Resolve one civic conflict, visit one vendor/forge surface, and unlock one route or faction consequence.

sessionTargets.label: Sub-city story
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Finish a district conflict, mini-boss, secret, or local NPC choice in a compact browser-game sitting.

sessionTargets.label: Road event route
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Make a route choice, resolve danger or reward, and see reputation, companion, or material impact immediately.

sessionTargets.label: Challenge dungeon
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Clear one readable enemy pack chain, one optional room, and one reward chest without requiring grind.

sessionTargets.label: Boss attempt
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Read telegraphs, spend one to four consumables, and understand a failure before retry.

sessionTargets.label: Relic trial
sessionTargets.playerPromise: Test a build against rotating affixes, claim a deterministic reward, and leave with a next target.

xpCurveAnchors.phase: Brass Warden and Veyrhold route unlock
Orrery, Verdant, Sable, and Ironbloom pressure
Nacre, Gloamreach, and Auric breach prep

levelBands.label: The First Reliquary
levelBands.balanceIntent: Fast tutorial growth with no farming.

levelBands.label: Act I Awakening
levelBands.balanceIntent: Starter builds and first upgraded item become meaningful.

levelBands.label: Act II City Pilgrimage
levelBands.balanceIntent: Class tools widen without forcing perfect gear.

levelBands.label: Act III Faction War
levelBands.balanceIntent: Faction choices and companion perks offset harder packs.

levelBands.label: Act IV Citadel Breach
levelBands.balanceIntent: Boss chains require readable resistances and consumable pressure.

levelBands.label: Act V World-Scar Restoration
levelBands.balanceIntent: Final forms test mastery, not raw grind.

levelBands.label: Relic Trials
levelBands.balanceIntent: Repeatable trials reward build experiments and collection goals.

lootCadence.label: Normal enemy pack
lootCadence.sourceRule: Materials or low gear should appear often enough to make every short fight readable.

lootCadence.label: Elite or champion
lootCadence.sourceRule: At least one useful material or comparison item per elite.

lootCadence.label: Sub-city chest
lootCadence.sourceRule: District chests seed local gear identity.

lootCadence.label: City boss
lootCadence.sourceRule: City boss reward must include a deterministic city-set or relic component.

lootCadence.label: Act boss
lootCadence.sourceRule: Act bosses move the build forward with a clear gear or skill unlock.

lootCadence.label: Hollow Regent finale
lootCadence.sourceRule: Finale rewards include postgame unlocks plus at least one memorable unique.

lootCadence.label: Postgame relic trial
lootCadence.sourceRule: Trials are deterministic enough to respect offline/local-first play.

bossTargets.label: The Brass Warden
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Every slam has a visible windup and a safe dodge lane.

bossTargets.label: Veyrhold city boss
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Shield enemies preview guard-break timing before the boss.

bossTargets.label: Cinderfall city boss
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Ember hazards use low-flash warning zones.

bossTargets.label: The Bannerless Admiral
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Adds introduce faction pressure without obscuring the boss.

bossTargets.label: The Sunken Choir
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Choral waves remain legible in reduced motion.

bossTargets.label: The Hollow Regent - Mercy Mask
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Dialogue choice and first form teach the painless-ending bargain.

bossTargets.label: The Hollow Regent - Crownless War
bossTargets.telegraphRule: City choices alter support cues but not core fairness.

bossTargets.label: The Hollow Regent - World-Scar Heart
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Final patterns demand mastery while preserving clear retry learning.

bossTargets.label: The Crownless Echo
bossTargets.telegraphRule: Elite affix rotation is announced before the arena locks.

lineageViability.hook: Ember resistance helps Cinderfall without trivializing frost or curse zones.
Reputation bonus speeds civic access but does not skip city boss gates.
Illusion reveal improves Mirrorglass routes while keeping combat stats fair.
Healing pressure improves safety but potion scarcity still matters.
Armor economy is cheaper, but movement penalties keep positioning relevant.
Archive rewards increase lore and material discovery without doubling gear drops.
Cooldown tempo rewards opener planning without invalidating other casters.
Dodge and travel advantages support skilled play without free boss clears.

upgradeEconomy.antiGrindRule: Available by the first forge pedestal.
One city arc should fund at least one +2 item.
Sub-city champions and salvage cover normal experimentation.
Reserved for act-boss prep and meaningful gear commitment.
One +5 item is expected before the finale, not a full +5 set.

inputFeelChecks.label: Keyboard primary
inputFeelChecks.acceptance: Inputs never type into the command box unless the box is focused.

inputFeelChecks.label: Pointer card RPG
inputFeelChecks.acceptance: Click-card actions update state for limited browser windows.

inputFeelChecks.label: Small viewport
inputFeelChecks.acceptance: Size controls preserve a dominant playfield in the Codex browser.

inputFeelChecks.label: Reduced motion
inputFeelChecks.acceptance: Telegraphs remain readable while shake, flash, and ambient motion calm down.
